$comment: Read by tools/desktop/audit-gate.mjs and apps/desktop/build-config.test.js. Raising minimumElectron is how a security release becomes mandatory for the build; an accepted advisory must name why and until when.

acceptedAdvisories.scope: build-time only (electron-builder, app-builder-lib, dmg-builder, @electron/universal); never shipped in the installer
acceptedAdvisories.reason: ReDoS through glob patterns. The only patterns these tools evaluate are the ones in apps/desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs, which we write. The fix is minimatch 11, a major version electron-builder 26 does not support; forcing it by override risks a packager that silently includes or omits files.
